# t2.1.1 — Persistence/repository foundation

## Status

**Complete.** Added a request-scoped async DB-session dependency and tenant-scoped SQLModel repositories for settings, request logs, issues, and detection runs. No schema, legacy route, or checklist changes were made.

## Implementation

- `get_db_session` yields a request-scoped `AsyncSession`, fails closed with `not_ready` if the app has no engine, and leaves commit/rollback boundaries to the route or service transaction.
- `BaseRepository` centralizes tenant-filtered selects and forces the repository owner's `user_id` onto inserted entities.
- `UserSettingsRepository` provides read, concurrency-safe first-read creation, and allowlisted partial updates.
- `RequestLogRepository` provides tenant-scoped lookup, parameterized filters, escaped text search, `(occurred_at, id)` keyset pagination, bounded list queries, ordered detection windows, insert, and source deletion.
- `IssueRepository` provides tenant-scoped reads, an explicit default-off experimental/Tier 3 gate, and source-aware deletion.
- `DetectionRunRepository` provides tenant-scoped lookup/latest-run ordering, insert, and source-aware deletion.
- Repositories flush but never commit, allowing API/service code to own atomic transaction boundaries.
- `overcall.db.repos` exports the repositories. No Mongo-style collection globals or compatibility aliases were introduced.

## Test Results

- Command: `python -m pytest -q -c <repo>/apps/api/pyproject.toml <repo>/apps/api/tests` (run from the system temp directory with `PYTHONPATH=<repo>/apps/api`, `CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173`, `SUPABASE_URL` removed, and `TEST_DATABASE_URL` unset)
- Passed: 60
- Failed: 0
- Skipped: 2
- Failure details: none in the isolated run. The two PostgreSQL integration checks were skipped because no test database was configured for this run.
- Runtime health verification: existing TestClient tests passed for `/healthz` (200) and `/readyz` (503 when no database is configured). This task introduced no REST routes.
- Additional checks: Ruff lint passed; Ruff format check passed.
- Environment note: a first full-suite run from `apps/api` inherited local settings and produced two environment-sensitive failures (the missing-secret test observed `SUPABASE_URL`; the CORS test's configured origin did not match its fixture). Re-running in an isolated temp working directory with test CORS configured passed. No secret values were read or recorded, and no unrelated config/CORS changes were made.

## Evidence Mapping

- `t2-architect.md#Material architecture findings 1 and 3` → SQLModel-backed repositories, request-scoped sessions, and no collection aliases in this implementation.
- `docs/PLAN.md#B6 REST API tasks 1 and 4` → session injection seam, tenant-scoped repository queries, keyset/filter support, source selection, and default-off experimental issue reads.
- `docs/PLAN.md#B4 runner task 4` → deterministic ordered log-window query and repository flush-without-commit semantics leave transaction ownership to the detection service.
- `t1-pm.md#Manual and external preconditions` → PostgreSQL integration, Supabase/provider, production, and soak criteria were not represented as verified.
